subject: english
question:
Select the correct option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If no substitution is required, select ‘No substitution’.

Shreya prefers ice-cream __than__ chocolates.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error in the sentence is the incorrect use of** "than" **instead of **"to" **after "prefer."
 
• The correct construction is** "prefer...to"** when making a choice between two options.
 
• **"Prefer...over" **is also a valid construction, but** "prefer...to" **is more commonly used.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **'to'.**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **'Option 1.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2) over:** This is another correct preposition to use after "prefer."
 
• **Option 4) from:** This preposition is not appropriate in this context.
